description: This Java class, PcbCopyTool, provides functionality for copying PCB configuration files, utilizing other classes like PcbNode and PcbMergeTool to read, modify, and write PCB data.

classes.name: PcbCopyTool
classes.description: Main class providing a command-line utility to copy and modify PCB configuration files.
